design.reason: R32 correctly closes the raw MODEL authority bypass at the design boundary and replaces structural RuntimeBindingPlan equality with exact runtime/context identity provenance. No new blocking Design defect was found.

findings.title: R34 conflates genuine pre-fix RED defects with future remediation-mechanism GREEN contracts
findings.fact: R34 requires every MANDATORY_RED to compile and be discovered on the pre-fix revision and rejects compile/setup/missing-class failure as INVALID_RED, while AUTHORITY-OPERATION-BINDING, AUTHORITY-TARGET-PATH-BINDING and CONTEXT-BINDING-LIFETIME describe R32 remediation mechanisms that may not exist on the pre-fix code object or may already be GREEN through existing guarded/lifecycle paths.
findings.risk: Development would receive an unsatisfiable or dishonest TDD gate and could be incentivized to manufacture non-semantic RED evidence.
findings.requiredRemediation: Reclassify the three future-mechanism contracts to GREEN_ONLY; retain only current-defect reproductions as MANDATORY_RED.
